evidence.moatW: 報告セグメント・営業セグメントとも1、売上12,241百万USD(FY2025)。10-Kが開示する売上分解は地域別のみで United States 4,814=39.3% / International 7,427=60.7%(出典:10-K FY2025 Segment and Geographic Information - Narrative および Schedule of Revenue by Geography)。売上の定義は『Our revenue consists of service fees, net of incentives and refunds, charged to our customers』(同10-K MD&A)＝予約に対する手数料という単一の役務。Experiences/Services は事業として展開中だが売上区分として別掲されず(ASC606の分解開示・ASC280の閾値に達していない)。→ 収益源は宿泊マーケットプレイスの両面ネットワーク1本で、売上の≥80%が同一の1製品ライン(宿泊予約手数料)。都市集中は『no single city represented more than 2% of our revenue』・最大顧客は個人ゲストで<10%だが、単一製品要件を満たさないため70には届かない → moatW=50
evidence.dom: 世界の短期賃貸(short-term rental)市場の2024年シェア: Airbnb 44% / Booking.com 18% / Vrbo(Expedia)9%、上位3社で71%。Airbnbは2019年の28%から44%へ拡大(出典: Skift Research 推計、市場規模1,830億USD。https://finance.yahoo.com/news/short-term-rentals-airbnbs-dominance-203000556.html)。40-69%のレンジ＝寡占の首位 → dom=70
evidence.irr: 50=代替容易。原本が両面とも選択肢の存在を明記:『We compete to attract and retain hosts to and on our platform to list their homes, experiences, and services, as hosts have a range of options for doing so』『We compete to attract and retain guests to and on our platform, as guests have a range of options to find and book accommodations, experiences, and services』。さらに供給の重複掲載を自認:『if they choose to cross-list or list exclusively with competitors ... our revenue and business operations could be adversely affected』。代替先も実名列挙:『online travel agencies (OTAs), such as Booking Holdings (including the brand Booking.com), Expedia Group (including the brands Expedia and VRBO), Trip.com Group』『internet search engines, such as Google』『hotel chains, such as Marriott, Hilton, Accor, and Wyndham』。契約拘束・規格ロックの記述は無し→50。出典: FY2025 Form 10-K Item 1 Competition https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1559720/000155972026000004/abnb-20251231.htm
evidence.rep: 60=困難(80/100も35も不可)。80超を否定する根拠は、同型の宿泊マーケットプレイスを既に運営する大手が実名で列挙されていること(Booking Holdings / Expedia Group(VRBO)/ Trip.com Group)。一方35(数年で追随可)を否定する根拠は、供給網の地理的広がりと無償流入:『We operate a global marketplace connecting guests with stays, experiences, and services, collectively in over 220 countries and regions』『61% of our revenue was generated from listings outside of the United States』『While performance marketing remains a component of our multi-faceted approach, the strength of Airbnb’s brand and our communication strategy has allowed us to maintain lower reliance on paid marketing channels』=有償広告に頼らぬ需要流入は数年で買えない。→60。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1559720/000155972026000004/abnb-20251231.htm
evidence.dur: 85=ネットワーク。堀の型は両面市場そのもの:『Our technology platform powers our two-sided global marketplace and supports the broad, evolving needs of our network of hosts and guests』。供給側の獲得要因の筆頭が需要量である点も両面性の直接証拠:『We compete for hosts based on many factors including the volume of bookings generated by guests』、需要側は在庫量:『We compete for guests based on many factors, including unique inventory and availability of listings』。ブランド(55)は原本にも登場するが(『the strength of Airbnb’s brand』)獲得要因の列挙中の一項目に過ぎず主機構ではない。規制/物理(100)・スイッチングコスト(75)は該当証拠なし→85。※dur は堀の『型』の分類であって強度ではない(強度側は irr=50・moatW=50・dom=70 が捕捉)。出典: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1559720/000155972026000004/abnb-20251231.htm
